references.text: The men who pursued the spies set out toward the Jordan, to the crossing points. Rahab's lie that the men had left led to this pursuit.
At the city gate in darkness, when the gate is shut, is a recurring motif of danger and escape at city gates.
Lot protected the angels in Sodom in a similar way to how Rahab protected the spies, by hiding guests from hostile townspeople.
Samson in Gaza - the city gate and darkness as themes, with enemies waiting at the gate to capture him.
The midwives lied to Pharaoh to protect the Hebrew baby boys, just as Rahab lied to protect the spies.
Mikal helped David escape and lied to Saul's men, in a similar way that Rahab helped the spies and misled their pursuers.
